_about: Human-reviewed reference labels approved by the Siyaq team. Only these may be used as verified evaluation reference data. Each entry records what was reviewed and how. Vehicle B is stored as a reviewed bounding box at one frame (normalised 0-1 image coordinates), so a prediction is matched by box overlap (IoU >= 0.5) and not by a tracker ID that can change between versions.
